_what: The three systems in the published measured table, as a roster the CLI can load. IDs, checkpoint hashes, arms and cross_runtime are copied verbatim from the roster that was actually scored; only the paths are rewritten as ordinary relative paths.
_paths: Relative, and fully expanded (no placeholders). `report` never opens these files — it reads metadata only — so the table regenerates from the published rows without any weights. To SCORE fresh, place the real files at these paths; `plan`/`run` re-hash them and refuse a mismatch.
_subset_reason: representative subset selected for time before any score was judged

systems.note: immutable read-only copy; ppo_latest.pt is a moving pointer and is refused
legacy-trained under the estimated runtime: a declared cross-runtime reference
